name: Sunanda Pattanaik Janah / सुनन्दा पट्टनायक जाना

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sunanda Pattanaik Janah writes Hindi poetry in Kabita Live, where her contributor note also records a love of music. A 2019 report in The Pioneer names her among the performers at Sawansandhya, a Bhubaneswar gathering devoted to poetry and music, placing these interests within a shared cultural setting.

In “सरहद”, the scent of food, a seed carried by rain and a flower’s fragrance challenge the divisions imposed by a border. “होली” gives voice to an invisible, colourless presence that carries breath, scent and the movement of coloured powder. Across both poems, what cannot be fenced or held becomes a way of imagining connection.
